name: Pi Coding Agent: Install, Sign In and Start Coding
description: Install Pi, open it in your project, use /login to connect a provider and /model to choose a model. Then give it a small, verifiable task. In CodeAgentSwarm, you can use the same agent through Chat and CLI views.
